name: New Haven County, CT
findings: New Haven County has 3,288 nonprofit organizations. 1,493 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,260 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, New Haven County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 31 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 13 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
